title: The Trojan Horse Isn't in the Iliad
title_ja: トロイの木馬は『イリアス』に出てこない
description:
Homer's Iliad ends with the funeral of Hector, before the wooden horse is ever built; the horse appears later, in the Odyssey.
Full episode: https://youtu.be/WSipndkxiiE

Music: Suno.

description_ja:

title: One of the Oldest Pictures of the Trojan Horse
title_ja: 最も古いトロイの木馬の絵の一つ
description:
A clay jar from Mykonos, made around 670 BC, shows a horse on wheels with warriors' faces in its windows. It is one of the oldest known pictures of the Trojan horse.
Full episode: https://youtu.be/WSipndkxiiE

Images
Mykonos 2240: Photo AbelDionis, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons.
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mykonos_Pithos_2240_(Trojan_Horse_detail).jpg
Narration: Kokoro / Heart (af_heart), synthetic speech.
Music: Suno.

#Shorts #History #TrojanHorse
description_ja:
紀元前670年ごろのミコノス島の甕には、車輪の上の馬と、窓からのぞく戦士の顔が描かれています。知られている中で最も古いトロイの木馬の絵の一つです。
本編：https://youtu.be/WSipndkxiiE

title: "Beware of Greeks Bearing Gifts" Isn't From Homer
title_ja: 「贈り物を持つギリシャ人に用心せよ」はホメロスではない
description:
The famous warning about Greeks bearing gifts comes from Virgil's Aeneid, written about two thousand years ago, not from Homer.
Full episode: https://youtu.be/WSipndkxiiE

Images
Rijksmuseum — Public domain. Object nos.: RP-P-OB-207.716, RP-P-2007-160.
https://www.rijksmuseum.nl/en/collection
Title card: Quiet Origins (quotation: Aeneid 2.49, trans. J. W. Mackail, 1885).
Narration: Kokoro / Heart (af_heart), synthetic speech.
Music: Suno.

#Shorts #History #TrojanHorse
description_ja:
贈り物を持つギリシャ人への有名な警告は、ホメロスではなく、およそ二千年前に書かれたウェルギリウスの『アエネーイス』から来ています。
本編：https://youtu.be/WSipndkxiiE
